name: Stop Ahead
spec: yellow diamond with a small red STOP octagon symbol and a black upward arrow
meaning: A stop sign is ahead; begin slowing now.

snippets.back: Pavement words warning of a school, railroad crossing or stop ahead require extra caution and preparation to stop.
STOP AHEAD and YIELD AHEAD signs warn that a STOP sign or a YIELD sign is coming up.
For a lawful right turn on red, you must come to a full stop ahead of the crosswalk before nearing the intersection.

Crosswalks frame legal pedestrian crossings, so halt behind the stop line, crosswalk, or sign and yield to anyone entering or inside, stay wary since many crossings lack paint, stop ahead of the intersection when no crossing shows, and honor a stop line before the crosswalk first.
A stop-symbol advance warning indicates a stop ahead, while a traffic-light-symbol warning indicates a signal ahead.
Some warning signs announce a control device before you reach it, such as Stop Ahead, Yield Ahead and Signal Ahead.
Roundabout Ahead, Stop Ahead and Yield Ahead signs warn that a roundabout, a stop sign or a yield sign is coming up.
A Stop Ahead sign means a stop sign is coming on your road, and a Signal Ahead sign means a traffic light is coming; be ready to stop for either.
